note: Fictional adults only. Identity text describes visible traits; the city is setting, never identity. MST (Monk Skin Tone 1-10) is audit metadata, not prompt text. Drafts need owner review and a local likeness check before use. Source: docs/research/diverse-characters-and-studios.md Each person needs an approved reference sheet (8 views, stored by the Studio with SHA-256) before shots count as referenced. Mascots are rendered by their rigs, never by diffusion.
